queries_run: Independent power producers tariff exposure gas turbine transformer supply chain 2026 Talen

findings.claim: Talen 10-K 風險因子：新增或提高的關稅、貿易限制可能實質墊高燃料、材料、設備、零件成本或影響取得，未量化；無出口管制／Entity List 相關內容。
findings.excerpt: Any new or increased trade tariffs, restrictions, or controls, as well as any resulting delays or disruptions in global supply chains or shipping channels, could materially increase the prices we pay for, or negatively impact our ability to obtain, on a timely basis or at all, fuel, materials, supplies, equipment, parts, and (or) other products critical to our operations.

findings.claim: Talen 在 2025 Q1 法說會稱新建複循環電廠設備多自歐洲採購，關稅與供應緊張使新建更貴（利於既有電廠稀缺性）。
findings.source: Talen Q1 2025 earnings call (allmind.ai 摘要)

reg_tariff_export.note: 未找到 Section 232 對 Talen 的專屬揭露、出口管制或中國相關暴露；Talen 為美國本土發電商。

clues.claim: Talen 稱設備多來自歐洲，關稅加供應緊使新建成本更高。
